description: baseline Billy reference (vocab=8192 BPE, no <cap>, CASEOPS_ENABLED=0)
comment: steps=4962 tok/s=6614279. Stage 5 internal anchor for the Billy <cap> sweep. CASEOPS=0 路径独立 BPB 计算（build_sentencepiece_luts），所以 T0 1.07063 / 1.06929 不能直接对比 stage1 A0 (CASEOPS=1) 的 1.07470 / 1.06172；TA-TF 共用同一 CASEOPS=0 路径，内部对比公平。

description: p=0.1 inverse_freq Billy <cap> (H1 minimal; PRE-PADDING-FIX, FAILED, kept as representative failure)
comment: steps=4618 tok/s=6078808. **Pre-padding-fix failure mode, kept as representative**: training + GPTQ OK but TTT eval crashed with `assert_size_stride(tanh, (64, s114, 8083), (1170432, 8128, 1))`. Root cause: VOCAB_SIZE=8128 was set DIRECTLY on cell config (with no source-of-truth pad logic), so build_sentencepiece_luts saw vocab=8128 but tokenizer reported vocab=8083; inductor's specialized cached kernel used both shapes inconsistently across forward/backward. Fixed in commit 37b5de6 by adding VOCAB_PAD_MULTIPLE env var (raw=8083 + pad=64 → padded=8128 at model construction time, single source of truth). Reproduced 2x in sweeps 20260429_025316 and 20260429_040050 before the fix landed; new TA in row 3 below uses the fixed code path.

description: p=0.1 inverse_freq Billy <cap> (H1 minimal, padded vocab=8128, removed 110 tokens, inflation 1.013×)
comment: steps=4922 tok/s=6545969. **Post-padding-fix successful run**. ttt_bpb 1.06889 vs T0 1.06929 = **−0.00040** ✓ H1 minimal weakly supported (within ±0.001 single-seed noise but on the right side). pre_quant 1.07034 vs T0 1.07063 = −0.00029 (essentially equal; inflation 1.013× cost cancelled by parameter saving). artifact 15,932,372 vs T0 15,950,599 = −18,227 bytes (consistent with 109 fewer raw vocab × 256 in/out / GPTQ compression ratio).

description: p=0.2 inverse_freq Billy <cap> (H1 conservative MAIN result, padded vocab=8000, removed 220 tokens, inflation 1.027×)
comment: steps=4954 tok/s=6599023. **Stage 5 best ttt_bpb so far**. ttt_bpb 1.06837 vs T0 1.06929 = **−0.00093** ✓ H1 conservative supported (twice the noise floor and consistent direction). pre_quant 1.06984 vs T0 1.07063 = −0.00078. artifact −57,699 bytes vs T0. Doubling p_sample from TA (110 → 220 tokens removed) gives −0.00046 ttt_bpb improvement on top of TA → diminishing-returns curve in the right direction. **Adopt p=0.2 inverse_freq as Billy <cap> recommended setting if no further cells beat it.**

description: p=0.5 inverse_freq fmax=0.01 Billy <cap> (H5 freq-gated: only remove tokens with freq < 1%, padded vocab=7744)
comment: steps=4905 tok/s=6517191. **H5 freq-gating refuted**. ttt_bpb 1.06987 vs T0 1.06929 = **+0.00058** (worse). The fmax=0.01 gate keeps high-frequency cap tokens but lets p=0.5 remove low-freq ones → 470 tokens removed, but inflation 1.043× hurts more than the parameter saving helps. artifact 15,828,127 (−122,472 vs T0) saves the most bytes of any cell so far, but at a BPB cost that crosses the +0.0005 threshold. Conclusion: aggressive removal even with frequency protection is net-negative; TB's p=0.2 is the local optimum.

description: p=0.5 inverse_freq Billy <cap> (H1 balanced / show-me, padded vocab=7680, removed 552 tokens, inflation 1.068×)
comment: steps=4924 tok/s=6545828. **Show-me region passes**. ttt_bpb 1.06879 vs T0 1.06929 = **−0.00050** ✓ H1 balanced supported. pre_quant −0.00035 vs T0. artifact 15,804,730 (−145,869 vs T0, biggest saving among all OK cells). Comparable to TA (−0.00040) but with 5× the parameter saving → TC is the **better cap-bytes-vs-bpb trade**. TC vs TB: TC saves 88,170 more bytes but loses 0.00042 ttt_bpb. The Pareto frontier between TB (best BPB) and TC (best bytes) suggests both are on the efficient curve; final pick depends on artifact_bytes target. Note TC sat in a separate sweep 20260429_085604 because the original 040050 sweep was stopped after TF; cells share identical envelope so the comparison is apples-to-apples.

description: p=0.5 uniform Billy <cap> (H2 negative control: same vocab/removed as TC, only sample mode differs)
comment: steps=4988 tok/s=6658359. **H2 weakly supported, inconclusive at single seed**. ttt_bpb 1.06893 vs T0 1.06929 = -0.00036 (uniform also wins vs baseline, surprisingly). TD vs TC = +0.00014 (inverse_freq remains direction-correct over uniform but inside the single-seed ±0.0001 noise floor). artifact bytes 15,817,466 essentially identical to TC 15,804,730 (both same vocab=7641 + bf16 GPTQ). To resolve H2 conclusively need 3-seed re-run on TC + TD; current single-seed delta is below noise. **But the indirect evidence is strong**: even uniform random delete only gives +0.00014 over best inverse_freq, so the freq-mass-affected metric (uniform 5.51% vs inverse_freq 1.18%) does NOT translate to BPB cost in proportion. Hypothesis update: BPB is dominated by inflation cost not by freq-mass disruption; at fixed inflation, sample mode is a second-order effect.

description: p=1.0 inverse_freq Billy <cap> (upper bound calibration: remove ALL eligible cap tokens, max inflation 1.135×)
comment: steps=4863 tok/s=6444130. **Surprising upper bound**: even at p=1.0 (1105 tokens removed, 13.5% inflation), ttt_bpb 1.06909 vs T0 1.06929 = -0.00020 (still slightly net positive, within noise). artifact bytes 15,650,823 = -299,776 vs T0 (largest byte saving in entire sweep). Compared to TB best (1.06837): TE - TB = +0.00072 (TE worse by ~7-9× the noise floor; TB remains the BPB winner). But TE - T0 ≥ 0 means: **the BPB cost of full <cap> removal is essentially zero**; the parameter-saving from -1105 vocab × 256 in/out exactly offsets the +13.5% inflation. This calibration anchors the "inflation does not break BPB" claim and lets us interpret the U-shape: TB (1.027x infl) is the bottom of the curve, TE (1.135x infl) returns to baseline, T0 (1.000x infl) is the right-side anchor.
